items.title: District Mineral Foundation marks 10 years
items.summary: The Meghalaya Government reported 923 projects worth ₹181.38 crore under the District Mineral Foundation, covering education, healthcare, sanitation, water supply and other needs of communities affected by mining.
items.exam: Mining-affected communities, development finance and local welfare.

items.title: Faith leaders engaged to support maternal and child health
items.summary: A state initiative uses trusted faith networks and a Mind-Heart Dialogue approach to encourage antenatal care, institutional delivery, postnatal care, breastfeeding, nutrition and routine immunisation.
items.exam: Public health, behaviour change and community engagement.

items.title: Wholesale inflation rises in September
items.summary: A report citing government data put September 2026 WPI inflation at 11.39%, up from 9.92% in August. WPI measures wholesale prices and is distinct from retail CPI inflation.
items.exam: Inflation indices, food and fuel prices, monetary policy.

items.title: Treasury-bill yields climb
items.summary: Reuters reported 182-day and 364-day Treasury-bill cut-off yields of 6.29% and 6.49%, respectively, as investors priced in the possibility of tighter monetary policy. These yields are distinct from the RBI repo rate.
items.exam: Government borrowing, Treasury bills and monetary policy.

items.title: Amazon fires intensify in Brazil
items.summary: Reuters reported 1,679 fires in Brazil's Amazonas state during the first two weeks of October, 253% more than the same period a year earlier. The report discussed delayed rainfall, El Niño, climate change and human activity as contributing factors; suspected deliberate burning was under investigation.
items.exam: Biodiversity, deforestation, air pollution and climate risk.
